settings.title: Crafted with Purpose. Designed for Living.

settings.editor:
At LuxNest, we believe that furniture is more than just function — it’s how you live, how you feel, and how you express your style.

From timeless classics to modern essentials, every piece we create is a blend of thoughtful design, fine craftsmanship, and lasting comfort.

We’re a team of designers, artisans, and furniture lovers who came together to build something better — a place where quality meets customization, and where homes are filled with pieces that feel truly personal.

Born from a passion for authentic design and sustainable living, we’ve grown into a trusted furniture brand for thousands of families, designers, and businesses across UK.

cards_list.item_desc: With a small workshop and a big dream, LuxNest was born in a quiet corner of London, UK. Our founders, passionate about timeless design and honest craftsmanship, started creating handcrafted wooden furniture for friends, family, and local clients.
We launched our first full collection: a blend of minimal design and traditional woodworking. It gained attention for its simplicity, quality, and sustainability.
Thanks to growing demand, we expanded into a larger studio space. This allowed us to increase production, collaborate with local artisans, and experiment with more materials and techniques.
We introduced bespoke furniture services — empowering clients to co-create their own unique pieces tailored to their space, lifestyle, and taste.
Our brand was featured in leading interior magazines and won our first award: Best Emerging Furniture Brand at the Furniture World Design.
Even during global challenges, we adapted. We launched our eCommerce store, offered virtual consultations, and introduced our Home Office Collection to meet changing lifestyles.
We achieved a major goal: 85% of our materials became sustainably sourced or recycled. Our packaging also became 100% plastic-free.
We proudly opened our first flagship showroom in [City]. A space to experience our collections in person and meet our design consultants.
We began offering full interior styling services and partnered with architects and property developers for residential and hospitality projects.
With growing international orders and recognition, we now ship worldwide — bringing our philosophy of warm, minimal living to homes across the globe.

settings.description_text: Every product starts with purpose — clean lines, functional form, and beauty that lasts.
We work with skilled local makers and use high-quality, responsibly sourced materials.
From sizes to colors and finishes — we help you create furniture that’s truly yours.
We don’t follow trends. We create collections with meaning, balance, and harmony.
